failure_taxonomy.rationale: The supplied equation is the NADH-dependent reduction of pyruvate to L-lactate with NAD+ formation, corresponding to lactate dehydrogenase reaction R00703.
Adenylosuccinate lyase catalyzes cleavage of SAICAR (C04823) to AICAR (C04677) and fumarate (C00122), matching the supplied equation exactly.

The equation represents formation of an enzyme–substrate complex between myosin light chain (C03875) and a Ca2+/calmodulin-bound myosin light-chain kinase complex. It does not include ATP, ADP, phosphate, or phosphorylated myosin light chain and therefore is not itself a catalogued KEGG biochemical conversion; it is a mechanistic binding step in an SBML signaling model.

The reaction is dissociation of an MLCK–myosin light chain complex into MLCK and MLC. This protein-complex binding/unbinding step does not provide the substrates (such as ATP) or phosphorylated product needed to identify a specific KEGG enzymatic reaction reliably.

failure_taxonomy.query_text: Hexokinase | Glucose in Cytosol; High energy phosphates -> Glucose 6 Phosphate | ATP concentration; ADP concentration
failure_taxonomy.rationale: Hexokinase reaction: ATP + D-glucose <=> ADP + D-glucose 6-phosphate. The participant compounds match glucose (C00293) and glucose 6-phosphate (C00668), while the pooled high-energy phosphate participant represents ATP/ADP.

failure_taxonomy.query_text: Hexokinase | Glucose in Cytosol; High energy phosphates -> Glucose 6 Phosphate
failure_taxonomy.rationale: The reaction is ATP-dependent phosphorylation of D-glucose to D-glucose 6-phosphate (with ADP as the corresponding high-energy-phosphate product), i.e. hexokinase/glucokinase. KEGG R00299 is the glucose + ATP <=> D-glucose 6-phosphate + ADP reaction.
The reaction is ATP-dependent phosphorylation of glucose to a hexose phosphate with ADP formation, corresponding to the canonical hexokinase/glucokinase reaction producing glucose 6-phosphate.

The reaction is NADH-dependent reduction of pyruvate to lactate with NAD+ formation, i.e. lactate dehydrogenase (pyruvate reductase). KEGG R00209 corresponds to pyruvate + NADH + H+ <=> L-lactate + NAD+; proton omission is common in SBML models.

The equation represents formation of an enzyme–substrate complex between myosin light chain (C03875) and a Ca2+/calmodulin-bound myosin light-chain kinase complex. It does not include ATP, ADP, phosphate, or phosphorylated myosin light chain and therefore is not itself a catalogued KEGG biochemical conversion; it is a mechanistic binding step in an SBML signaling model.

pilot_estimand.overall_accuracy_scope: Overall 30-31% exact Top-1 describes this constructed validation pilot only. It is not an estimate of corpus-wide accuracy.
pilot_estimand.principal_interpretable_results: Stratum-specific rates and paired comparisons across context variants are the principal interpretable results. The 489 prompts are three paired conditions on 163 reactions, not 489 independent biological examples.
pilot_estimand.sampling: The 163-reaction validation pilot deliberately oversamples Phase 2 failure strata. Documented quota shortfalls are part of the frozen sample.
